name: sticky-hero-scroll
title: Sticky Hero Scroll
blurb: Scroll-stacked hero with two sticky sections that scale and rotate on parallax.
description: 200vh container with two sticky viewport-height sections layered on scroll. Section 1 (light) scales down and rotates while Section 2 (dark) scales up. Grid pattern overlays. No props, default export.
use_when: Showcase layout where staggered scroll reveals are more important than instant hero impact.
avoid_when: Heavy motion; no prefers-reduced-motion guard. Images use external URLs.
a11y: Heading text is readable. Images have alt text. Motion-heavy experience may disorient some users.
